title: Towards the Roof of the World: NLP Progress in Tibetan Languages
abstract: arXiv:2610.13398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tibetan, spoken by some seven million people on and around the Qinghai-Xizang Plateau, remains underrepresented in natural language processing (NLP). We present, to our knowledge, the first peer-reviewed systematic bibliometric survey of Tibetan NLP: 140 publications from 2004 to 2026 in the ACL Anthology and DBLP, annotated for venue type, research area, first-affiliation country, and resource release. Output has grown rapidly, with 84% of the publications appearing since 2018, and has expanded bottom-up along the NLP pipeline, from corpora and word segmentation through script, speech, and applications to large language models (LLMs). Researchers based in China first-authored 87% of the publications, which span all 25 represented research areas, whereas work from other countries concentrates on Classical Tibetan. We argue that this full-pipeline paradigm, realized under the compounded constraints of a complex script, dialectal diversity

translated_title: 迈向世界之巅：藏语自然语言处理进展
translated_abstract: 藏语是青藏高原及其周边地区约七百万人使用的语言，但在自然语言处理（NLP）领域中仍代表性不足。据我们所知，本文提出了首个经同行评审的藏语NLP系统性文献计量调查：涵盖2004年至2026年间ACL Anthology和DBLP中的140篇出版物，并对发表载体类型、研究领域、第一作者所属国家以及资源发布情况进行了标注。研究成果增长迅速，其中84%的出版物发表于2018年以后，并沿着NLP流水线自下而上不断扩展，从语料库和分词，经文字、语音和应用，发展到大语言模型（LLMs）。中国的研究人员担任了87%出版物的第一作者，这些出版物涵盖所有25个代表性研究领域，而其他国家的工作则集中于古典藏文。我们认为，这一全流水线研究范式是在复杂文字、方言多样性等多重约束条件下实现的……
tldr: 本文开展了首个经同行评审的藏语NLP系统性文献计量调查，通过分析2004至2026年间140篇出版物，揭示了中国研究人员主导的全流水线研究范式如何在复杂文字与方言多样性等约束下推动藏语NLP的快速发展。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first peer-reviewed systematic bibliometric survey of Tibetan NLP, analyzing 140 publications from 2004 to 2026 and revealing a China-led full-pipeline research paradigm that has driven Tibetan NLP from corpora and word segmentation to large language models under the compounded constraints of a complex script and dialectal diversity.
